NDT training in El Segundo: how it works for El Segundo employers and technicians

Short answer: Atlantis NDT trains El Segundo technicians to ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level I, II and III in UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT, VT and ET. Theory runs live online or onsite at your facility in the South Bay, the practical is done on real specimens under an ASNT Level III, and your employer certifies you under its written practice. We have no classroom in El Segundo; we train at your site or online.

El Segundo is unusual because two very different inspection cultures sit a few blocks apart. On one side is a large refinery and the contractors that maintain it, working to ASME and API codes, owner inspection programmes and California's refinery safety rules. On the other is a dense cluster of space, satellite, defence and aerospace manufacturers, where NDT is controlled by customer specifications, NAS 410 and tightly qualified processes. Technicians move between the two more often than people expect, and the same method name, penetrant testing, for example, can mean quite different work on each side. This section is written around that split.

If you already know what you need, request an El Segundo training quote. Cohort and onsite quotes come back within one business day.

ASNT Level I, II and III courses available in El Segundo

All courses follow the SNT-TC-1A body of knowledge and are taught by an ASNT Level III. The table maps each method to typical South Bay work. Prerequisites are the usual entry points; your employer's written practice governs.

MethodLevelsWhat El Segundo employers use it forPrerequisite
UT (ultrasonic testing)I, II, III prepThickness surveys and weld UT on refinery piping and vessels; bond and laminate checks and machined-part inspection in manufacturingLevel I: none. Level II: Level I training and documented experience
PAUT (phased array UT)II, III prepCorrosion mapping and weld imaging during refinery turnarounds; advanced inspection of manufactured structuresUsually UT Level II first
TOFD (time-of-flight diffraction)II, III prepFlaw sizing in thick-wall refinery vessel and piping weldsUsually UT Level II first
RT (radiographic testing)I, II, III prepPipe weld radiography; film and digital interpretation; castings and assembliesLevel I: none. California radiographer requirements apply separately
MT (magnetic particle testing)I, II, III prepFerritic welds, lifting equipment and structural steel; ferromagnetic machined partsNone for Level I
PT (penetrant testing)I, II, III prepStainless and alloy welds in the refinery; non-magnetic machined, cast and welded parts in manufacturingNone for Level I
VT (visual testing)I, II, III prepWeld visual, in-service inspection walk-downs, receiving and in-process inspectionNone for Level I
ET (eddy current testing)I, II, III prepHeat-exchanger tubing in the refinery; surface cracks and conductivity on aluminium partsBasic electrical knowledge helps

A plain statement on scope: production aerospace NDT in El Segundo is normally certified to NAS 410 by the aerospace employer, and we do not train to NAS 410. Our courses suit employers working to SNT-TC-1A, which covers the refinery side, most contractors and many manufacturing and test-lab roles, and they give technicians a strong technical base in each method. Level III candidates can follow the ASNT Level III training track.

SNT-TC-1A certification path in El Segundo, step by step

  1. Employer written practice. Defines levels, methods, training and experience hours, exam content, vision requirements and the responsible Level III.
  2. Formal training in the method, live online or onsite, with attendance and content records.
  3. On-the-job experience, supervised, logged and signed.
  4. General, specific and practical examinations prepared and graded under an ASNT Level III; the practical is on real specimens.
  5. Vision examination, near-vision acuity and colour contrast, every year.
  6. Employer certification, signed by the employer and valid while you work there.
  7. Recertification at the interval the written practice sets.

Recommended hours by method and level are in our SNT-TC-1A training requirements matrix. Refinery owners and manufacturing customers often require more than the minimum, and your written practice will say so.

Online, live-virtual or onsite NDT training for El Segundo crews

  • Live online theory in Pacific Time, instructor-led with real-time questions. It suits technicians who would otherwise lose half a day to South Bay traffic. See NDT training online.
  • Onsite at your facility in El Segundo, Torrance, Carson, Hawthorne, Long Beach or anywhere in the LA Basin. Your team trains on its own equipment and procedures.
  • Blended: theory online, then a concentrated practical block at your site.

Refinery contractors plan around turnaround schedules, and manufacturing teams plan around delivery milestones and launch campaigns. We schedule cohorts to fit, often running theory before a turnaround and practicals after. Ask about onsite training for your El Segundo team, or see corporate NDT training for multi-site programmes.

Where NDT technicians work in El Segundo

Refining and fuels

The refinery and the inspection contractors that support it run continuous fixed-equipment programmes, with peaks during turnarounds. UT thickness and weld examination, PAUT and TOFD on critical welds, RT of piping, ET on exchanger bundles and PT on alloy welds are all in demand. Examination methods typically follow ASME Section V, with acceptance from ASME Section VIII for vessels and B31.3 for piping, and the owner's in-service programme referencing API inspection codes. California also applies a refinery-specific Process Safety Management regulation (Cal/OSHA, Title 8 section 5189.1) that puts weight on mechanical integrity, which in practice means documented, qualified inspection.

Space, satellite and defence manufacturing

Spacecraft, satellite, launch-vehicle and defence electronics manufacturers in and around El Segundo and Hawthorne use PT, UT, RT and ET on flight hardware, plus specialised methods on composites and bonded structures. Personnel certification is usually to NAS 410, and processes are controlled by customer specifications and industry standards such as ASTM E1417 for penetrant.

Test labs, machine shops and suppliers

A wide supplier base of machine shops, heat treaters, platers and independent test labs serves both sides. Smaller labs often certify some staff under SNT-TC-1A for industrial customers and others under NAS 410 for aerospace customers, which makes a clean written practice especially important.

Ports, power and construction

The Ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach, regional power plants and constant structural construction across the basin add MT, UT and VT work to AWS D1.1, plus marine work on vessels and terminals.

Radiography licensing in California

California is an NRC Agreement State. Industrial radiography is licensed by the Radiologic Health Branch of the California Department of Public Health, and companies licensed elsewhere need California authorisation before working in the state. California has its own industrial radiographer certification requirements under Title 17 of the California Code of Regulations, and the RHB decides which radiographer certifications it accepts. Check current RHB guidance before a crew mobilises. An SNT-TC-1A RT certification covers technique and interpretation; it does not replace state radiographer certification or radiation-safety training.

TWIC and site access

Port facilities require a TWIC card for unescorted access to secure areas. Refinery contractors complete owner safety orientation, and defence manufacturers have their own security processes. None of these is part of NDT certification, but each affects when a new technician can start.

Method spotlight: penetrant testing on flight hardware versus refinery welds

Penetrant testing is a good example of why El Segundo technicians need to understand the method, not just a procedure. The physics is the same everywhere: a liquid is drawn into a surface-breaking discontinuity, the excess is removed, and a developer draws the trapped liquid back out to form a visible indication. How that is controlled differs sharply between the two local industries.

Refinery and fabrication PT is usually solvent-removable, visible (red) dye on welds, performed in the field to a procedure written against ASME Section V Article 6. The critical controls are surface preparation on weld caps that may carry spatter and scale, dwell time, removal by wiping rather than flushing, a thin even developer coat, and the temperature of the part. Acceptance comes from the construction code or the owner's specification.

Aerospace PT is usually fluorescent penetrant inspection in a processing line, controlled by standards such as ASTM E1417. The process is described by penetrant type, removal method (water-washable, lipophilic or hydrophilic post-emulsifiable, or solvent-removable) and a sensitivity level from low to ultra-high. Line controls include water temperature and pressure, emulsifier concentration and contact time, drying oven temperature, UV-A intensity and white-light limits in the booth, and periodic system checks with known-defect panels. Parts are often machined, etched or shot-peened, and those surface conditions change detectability.

In an SNT-TC-1A PT course we teach both families: the physics, the materials, the processing variables and the interpretation of indications. That gives refinery technicians a real understanding of fluorescent systems and gives manufacturing technicians the field skills they need when they cross over. Aerospace certification itself is then completed with the aerospace employer under NAS 410. Ask about PT training for your El Segundo team.

Local options compared: NDT training in and around El Segundo

Los Angeles has more NDT training choices than most metros. Here is an honest list of the ones we could verify.

  • American Aerospace Technical Academy (Los Angeles). An aerospace-focused NDT training provider that advertises free tuition for qualifying students and actively recruits veterans and women. A strong option for individuals who qualify.
  • Hellier NDT (Anaheim). A long-established NDT training centre in Orange County, now part of a larger inspection group, running scheduled open-enrolment classes.
  • Other Southern California private schools. Several smaller schools in the region run scheduled courses aligned with SNT-TC-1A, and some cover NAS 410 aerospace requirements as well.
  • Local community colleges. South Bay colleges such as El Camino College run welding and manufacturing programmes. We could not confirm a stand-alone ASNT NDT certificate at them.
  • ASNT Greater Los Angeles Section. ASNT lists a Greater Los Angeles section with regular meetings. It is a good way to meet Level IIIs from both the refining and aerospace sides; check ASNT's directory for current details.
  • Atlantis NDT. No El Segundo or Los Angeles centre. We deliver live online theory and onsite cohorts at your facility under an ASNT Level III, and we write and maintain SNT-TC-1A written practices. Best fit: South Bay employers with a crew to qualify under SNT-TC-1A, especially refinery contractors and labs, and technicians whose employer will certify them.

An open-enrolment school suits an individual building a résumé. An employer cohort suits a company that needs certified people under its own written practice. If you already have an employer, ask which training its written practice accepts before you enrol anywhere.

Level III services and written practices for El Segundo NDT companies

South Bay inspection firms and labs are audited often: by refinery owners, by prime contractors, and by their own customers' quality teams. A written practice that matches what the company actually does is the foundation. Atlantis supports El Segundo companies with:

  • Written practice development and review for SNT-TC-1A programmes. See written practice development.
  • Level III examination services: general, specific and practical exams under your written practice, with records ready for audit.
  • Procedure writing and review against ASME Section V and the codes and specifications your clients name.
  • Team certification programmes. See the SNT-TC-1A training and certification programme.

Running SNT-TC-1A and NAS 410 in the same company

Many South Bay labs certify some staff to SNT-TC-1A and others to NAS 410. The two schemes differ on training and experience minimums, examination rules, the role of the responsible Level III, and recertification. Keeping them in separate, clearly scoped written practices, rather than one document that tries to do both, prevents the most common audit finding we see: a technician working on a contract under the wrong certification. We support the SNT-TC-1A side and can review how it interfaces with your aerospace programme.

For consulting in the area, see our NDT consulting page for El Segundo, NDT consulting in Los Angeles and NDT consulting in California. For training across the region, see the California NDT training hub, NDT training in Los Angeles, NDT training in San Diego and NDT training on the West Coast. Book a Level III consultation before your next audit.

Practise before the practical exam

The Practical NDT simulator lets trainees practise 12 methods in five 3D environments: an NDT lab, a welding workshop, an aircraft hangar, an oil and gas site and a storage tank, which covers both of El Segundo's main industries. See also Practical NDT for Los Angeles.

It is practice only. The practical examination is done on real specimens under a Level III, and the simulator does not replace it.

Your instructor

Training is led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III and founder of Atlantis NDT. He oversees course content, examinations and written-practice work for each El Segundo cohort.

Frequently asked questions about NDT training in El Segundo

How do I get NDT certified in El Segundo?

Complete formal training in a method, gain documented on-the-job experience, pass general, specific and practical exams under a Level III, pass a vision test, and be certified by your employer under its written practice. Start with an El Segundo course enquiry.

Can I take NDT training online in California?

Yes, for the classroom portion. The hands-on practical and practical exam need real equipment and specimens, onsite at your employer or in a blended programme. See NDT training online.

How long does UT Level 2 training take?

It depends on the classroom and experience hours your employer's written practice sets and whether you hold Level I already. Recommended minimums are in the training requirements matrix; experience usually takes longest.

Do I need a licence for radiography in California?

Your company needs a radioactive materials licence or California authorisation from the CDPH Radiologic Health Branch, and radiographers must meet California's radiographer certification and radiation-safety training requirements. SNT-TC-1A RT certification is separate.

What does NDT training cost in El Segundo?

We do not publish prices. Cost depends on method, level, group size and online or onsite delivery. Send your details and we will quote within one business day.

Is ASNT certification recognised by El Segundo employers?

Yes, on the refinery, contractor and general industrial side, where SNT-TC-1A is the common basis. Aerospace and space manufacturers usually require NAS 410, issued by the employer. Check the job specification.

Do I need NAS 410 to work in El Segundo aerospace?

For production aerospace NDT, usually yes. We do not train to NAS 410, but an SNT-TC-1A foundation in the same method makes the transition easier.

Can I use the GI Bill or WIOA to pay for NDT training?

GI Bill and VR&E benefits pay only for programmes approved for VA benefits, and WIOA requires a provider on California's eligible training provider list. Atlantis does not claim either approval. The usual route with us is employer-paid training. If you need free or funded training as an individual, check the approval status of local providers directly.

Can you train our team at our facility in the South Bay?

Yes. Onsite training at your facility is our standard model for teams. Ask about onsite training for your El Segundo crew.

Is there an NDT school in El Segundo?

We are not aware of one inside El Segundo itself, though the Los Angeles area has several training providers listed above. Atlantis has no physical centre in El Segundo; we train online and onsite.

Can I prepare for ASNT Level III from El Segundo?

Yes. Level III preparation runs live online. See ASNT Level III training.

How should I practise for the practical exam?

Use the Practical NDT simulator, work through question sets such as our UT Level 2 practice questions, and get supervised time on real equipment.

What do NDT technicians earn in California?

Pay depends on level, method and industry. See our NDT salary guide for context.
